reviews.text: AJ was great through the whole process! He kept us informed and did a fantastic job bringing our shower and bathroom back to life! Would highly recommend to anyone looking for their home tile upgrade!! Thanks AJ!

The team at Tile Envy completed a full main bath gut and remodel in a home we had just purchased, they did an amazing job!! They were polite, professional, and attentive right from the start. This was actually two separate rooms, they tore the wall down and made it into one large space, exactly what we were looking for!! The attention to detail was impeccable, I'm still amazed at how perfectly every tile lines up. It took a little bit longer than originally estimated, but you can't rush perfection! They took what was the worst space in our house and turned it into our favorite!

facts.services: New tile shower installations; full shower remodels; Schluter waterproof shower systems; bathroom remodels; failed shower diagnosis and rebuilds; tile and grout repair
facts.service_areas: La Porte, IN; Northwest Indiana; Southwest Michigan
facts.about_text: Tile Envy is a leading Tile Shower Specialist providing new tile shower installations and full shower remodels. We design and build high performance shower systems using proper waterproofing methods and techniques such as TCNA, CTI, NTCA industry standards, and proven tile installation methods for long lasting performance and durability to protect your investment. We also diagnose and correct failed showers, tile, and grout issues, with many repairs leading to partial or full system rebuilds. Serving residential clients throughout Southwest Michigan and the Lake Michigan shoreline, with limited service area into Northwest Indiana.
